steps.prompt: A festive fairground paint-festival finish arch gateway: two tall cream-ivory round columns standing on turned brass plinths with rose-pink and mint-green bands, joined at the top by a gently curved ivory arch beam with brass clasp rings, a golden paint-pot finial with blue paint on top of the keystone, a row of colourful scalloped pennant flags hanging under the arch, a fan of rainbow paint-stripe rays at each column top, the opening between the columns completely clear and wide. Photograph of a real glossy designer vinyl art-toy collectible, smooth sculpted soft-vinyl and lacquered resin surfaces, saturated candy paint colours with real paint drips, crisp studio product lighting, high detail. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
